proves.claim: lagLine for a checkout whose HEAD equals the trunk tip returns null and launches no git process, with the trunk ref loose and packed.

cli.io-next-lag.level-checkout-launches-.why: Without it, a regression where every next launches git rev-list to learn a level checkout is zero commits behind would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: A checkout 3 commits behind main prints the lag line that git's own count and base age give, with the trunk ref loose and packed.

cli.io-next-lag.three-behind-same-line.why: Without it, a regression where the file read of the trunk tip hides a real lag, or changes the line, would pass unnoticed.
